latest_cos_commentary.headline: Swipe Savvy is an Orlando-based, founder-led unified POS/payments/loyalty platform that acquired restaurant social-impact marketing platform GiftAMeal in April 2026 to expand its guest-engagement offering.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Directly competes with Genius across POS, payments, and loyalty_engagement product lines as an all-in-one platform aimed at small-to-midsize multi-industry merchants including restaurants.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Made an acquisition (GiftAMeal, April 2026) to add a differentiated cause-marketing/loyalty feature (meal-donation-triggered engagement) to its platform, expanding beyond core POS/payments into social-impact guest engagement.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: In small-merchant/independent-restaurant competitive situations, note that Swipe Savvy bundles POS, payments, and loyalty at a low published entry price point ($69/mo); confirm total cost of ownership including payment processing rates, which are not disclosed on the public pricing page.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Published pricing covers the software tier only; full payment-processing rate structure was not disclosed in sourced materials, so direct cost comparisons should be treated as incomplete.

verification_needed: named restaurant customers beyond GiftAMeal network
